decisions.rule: Do not merge Camilla Stephenson, Camilla Stevenson, Camila Stephenson and Kamilah Stevenson without a public identity cross-link or direct confirmation. Preserve each channel/person as a separate entity until resolved.

Classify YouTube claims as creator commentary/opinion, capture exact video URL, publication date and observed engagement counts, and independently corroborate factual claims before adding them to evidence or prediction features.
A web-search result set is not an exhaustive channel upload inventory. Require a verified channel ID and complete public uploads feed before claiming all videos have been inventoried.
Creator narratives about XRP custody, yen carry trades or liquidity are public-discourse features only; do not treat them as actual custody movements, capital flows or causal market evidence.
